root_cause.text: In `netfs_read_unlock_folios()`, the folio unlock decision used the file size (`rreq->i_size`) as the end bound, causing a folio containing the EOF to be unlocked as soon as collected read results reached EOF, even though a zero‑filling subrequest for the tail beyond EOF had not yet completed, allowing userspace to see uninitialized data via mmap.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `fend = umin(fpos + fsize, rreq->i_size)` to `fend = fpos + fsize`, ensuring the folio is only unlocked when all data up to the end of the folio has been accounted for, including the ZERO subreq that clears bytes past EOF.
